tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma ku ru kul+le'i dbang gi sbyin sreg gi cho ga gsal ba/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ pad+ma gar dbang bla ma rje// khams gsum dbang bsdud rig byed ma// dbyer med zhabs kyi pad+mor ni// btud nas sbyin sreg cho ga bri/ de la 'dir rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma ku ru kul+le'i dbang du bya ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga la don gsum ste/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la/ dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ stegs bu gru bzhi pa/ dpangs sor bzhi'i tshad la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa ngos snyoms shing*/ kha dog dmar por bsgyur ba/ de'i steng du/ brus pa'am/ rtsigs pa bris pa gang yang rung ba'i thab zla gam mdun ngos ring ba la khru gang*/ thung ba la khru phyed/ de'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar ut+pal dmar po/ 'dab ma rnams la/ ut+pa la'i lcags kyu dmar po/ de rnams kyi phyi rol du kha khyer sor bzhi bskor ba la/ pad+ma dmar po dang*/ ut+pa la'i lcags kyu spel ba bri/ de'i phyi rol du mu ran sor bzhi bskor ba la rdo rje'i phreng ba dang*/ pad+ma spel ba bri/ de thams cad kha dog dmar po la re kha dkar pos dbye ba bri'o// bud shing ni tsan+dan dmar po'am/ de ma 'byor na sed+dheng ngam/ shug pa'am/ mdzo mo shing la sogs pa kha dog dmar por yod pa'am/ mtshal dang rtsags la sogs pas dmar por bsgyur bas kyang rung ngo*// de lta bu'i bud shing gis thab kyi nang du khru phyed kyi dpang yod pa rtsigs/ de'i nang shar lho'i mtshams su zan gyi ting lo zhun mar dmar po sgron me dang bcas pa bshams/ bsreg rdzas ni/ rang gi g.yas/ thab kyi g.yon nas tshur rim bzhin yam shing*/ gong du bshad pa'i shing dmar po/ sboms su mthe'u chung gi tshad/ ring thung sor lnga pa/ dri bzang dang*/ mngar gsum gyis sbags pa/ sbyin sreg ci tsam byed pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa/

mar khu dmar po/ til nag zas mchog 'bras ma chag pa/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro/ durba/ ku sha bsreg rdzas rnams kha dog dmar por bsgyur ba/ yam shing khru gang pa ras kyis dkris pa la mar khu dmar pos sbags pa/ gzhan yang me mched sla ba'i shing seg phra mo/ rlung g.yab/ 'phral du gang dgos kyi bud shing*/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad dang bcas pa/ thab dang*/ sgrub pa po'i bar du me yol dkar zhal gyis byug pa la wam̐ yig bris pa/ rang gi mdun du/ bsang chu'i snod dung chos/ ku sha'i 'thor g.yab/ rdo rje dril bu nang mchod ka pa la dang bcas pa bshams/ rdo rje dril bu'i bar du dgang gzar blug kha sbyar la bzhag so sor kha phral nas bzhag na mi shis par bshad/ de thams cad la bdud rtsi ril bu dang sbyar ba'i nang mchod kyis bran/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ de nas phyi dro'i dus la bab pa na/ rnal 'byor pa rgyan gos dmar po dang ldan zhing*/ chags pa'i bsam pas/ kha nub du bltas la/ pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyi 'dug nas/ bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs tshar chen rin po ches mdzad pa ni/ na mo gu ru/ srid gsum dbang byed rje btsun rigs byed ma// gang des rjes bzung lhan skyes rol pa'i zhabs// rdo rje gdan pa a mo gha badz+ra// gsol ba 'debs so dbang gi dngos grub stsol// skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po rin chen grags// snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa// sras kyi thu bo rje btsun sku mched gnyis// gsol ba 'debs so= sa skya paṇa chen glo bo lo tsā ba// 'gro mgon 'phags pa rgyal tshab chos dbang zhabs// mkhas mchog yon tan khri dang seṅge bzang*// gsol ba 'debs so= /yar lung pa dang dpon sras rgyal ba mchog /'jam dbyangs chen po bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*// kun spangs chos rje blo gsal rgya mtsho'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so= /mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel zhabs// dbang phyug rab brtan ngag dbang chos grags dpal// ngag dbang rnam rgyal kun dga' bkra shis la// gsol ba 'debs so=

/rmor chen rje dang khyab bdag gnas gsar ba// kun dga' blo gros nam mkha' 'chi med zhabs// kun dga' bstan 'dzin chos rgyal a nan+dar// gsol ba 'debs so= /kun dga' dpal ldan shar chen rdo rje 'chang*// mkhyen brtse'i dbang po 'jam dbyangs blo gter dbang*// chos kyi blo gros rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so dbang gi dngos grub stsol// de ltar rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs dang*// rje btsun dbang mo'i thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis// brtan g.yo'i dngos kun bdag gis dbang bsgyur nas// pad+ma gar dbang 'grub pa'i sa thob shog /ces dang*/ de nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs dang*/ chos thams cad 'od gsal gyi rnam rol du blta zhing*/ khyad par gnas khang kyang dbang gi gzhal yas khang pad+ma rā ga las grub pa'i dag gsal gnyis med kyi dbus su thun mong ma yin pa'i/ skyabs yul/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad nyi la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ mtshan dpas spras pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sku gsung thugs la skyabs yul kun 'dus su gsal btab la/ skyabs 'gro ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus dang*/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes dang*/ bdag gis bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du rab 'byams dbang gi phrin las bsgrub par bya/

de'i phyir du bcom ldan 'das ma ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ de nas rang nyid skad cig gis ku ru kul+le'i dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis mar gsal ba'i snying khar ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar gsal las 'od zer dpag med 'phros/ lho phyogs kyi ri ku ru kul+le'i ngos nas rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma 'od dpag med kyis gtsug na brgyan pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ shrī ku ru kul+le maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ gu ru shrī ku ru kul+le maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhup+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra a lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong bskyed par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig

ces tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ tshogs zhing rnams rang gi spyi bo nas thim/ snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu ste rang rje btsun mar gsal ba la thim/ de yang thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim/ hrīḥyang rim bzhin 'od du zhu nas spros bral gyi ngang du bzhag la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po zhu ba las sna tshogs rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje sa gzhi/ rwa ba drwa ba gur dang bcas pa'i phyi rol du kha dog rnam lnga'i ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar zhing 'khrugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis brtan par bya/ de lta bu'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mi ro mgo g.yon du phyogs pa'i snying gar hrīḥdamar po las ut+pa la dmar po'i ze'u 'bru la hrīḥs mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer dmar po phyogs bcur 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi ma dag pa'i khams sbyangs/ brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad ku ru kul+le'i rnam par dbang du bsdus te/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le ye shes kyi sku can/ sku mdog dmar zhing snum pa rgya skyegs kyi me tog gsar pa'i mdangs can zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma lang tsho brgyad gnyis lon pa'i dpal yon can/ cung zad 'dzum zhing khro ba'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mchu'i sgros legs pa'i pad+ma tshem dkar gyi ze'u 'brus spras pa'i khrod na ljags kyi bung ba gar bsgyur ba/ dmar zlum gyi spyan gsum g.yon phyogs su zur gyis gzigs pas/

skal ldan gyi snying la bde ba ster ba/ dbu skra khams shing snum pa gyen du cung zad rlung gis bskyod pa'i rnam pa la thod skam lnga dang dar dpyangs kyis bcings pa/ mgo rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ rtsa phyag dang po gnyis kyis ut+pal dmar po'i myu gu'i mda' me tog sngon po kha bye la khad pa mde'u'i tshul dang*/ ut+pal dmar po'i gzhu gzhu rgyud dang sbyar te rna ba'i drung du 'gengs pa/ g.yas 'og mas ut+pal dmar po'i lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon 'og mas ut+pal dmar po'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ rab tu sgeg cing 'o 'dzin dang chu 'dzin rnam par rgyas pa/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ stag lpags gsar pa'i sham thabs sder phreng dang bcas pas sku smad dkris pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang pa'i gar stabs kyis 'gyings zhing chags pa'i nyams can/ mthong thos dran pa'i skye dgu'i yid 'phrog cing dbang du sdud pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kun nas gzi 'od 'bar ba'i rgyab yol dang 'od kor gyi dbus na bzhugs par bsam/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le la sangs rgyas byang sems pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs ye shes pa spyan drangs/ oṃ ku ru kul+le maṇ+ḍal la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la dgug gzhug bcings shing dbang du byas par bsam mo// slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs ye shes pa spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba rtsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas/ oṃ ku ru kul+le maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ ku ru kul+le maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ ku ru kul+le maṇ+ḍa la sa pā ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ nang mchod/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkha' rlung dang me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang gi dbus su go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi mu shu ma ra las bdud rtsi lnga/ bh+rūm̐ aṃ dziṃ khaṃ hūm̐ las ye shes lnga/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gsum mgo thur du bstan par bsam/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol/ 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug ste ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes pas byin gyis rlabs te bdud rtsi myong bas rang gi rtsa gnas thams cad bdud rtsi'i gang bas zag med kyi bde chen rgyud la skyes par bsam/ de nas/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdungs// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod// 'dod chags chen pos rjes chags pa// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces yid mchod kyang spro na bya'o// brtse bas rjes chags pad+ma rā ga'i mdog

/zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis mdzes pa'i sku// ye shes mda' gzhu ut+pal lcags kyu 'dzin// rje btsun rigs byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod de/ 'dir man ngag thob pas dbang byin rlabs gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang gi gsung ltar bsgom/ de nas/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥyig dmar po'i mthar g.yas skor du oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags bye ru'i phreng ba lta bu 'od zer dmar po 'bar ba dang bcas pa las 'od zer dmar po phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa 'jig rten pa che zhing che ba rnams dang mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/ rigs ldan rgyal blon/ rig ma rta glang nor bu dbang gi rgyal po la sogs pa srid zhi'i dpal 'byor gyi yon tan nus pa mthu stobs thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par bsdus te bdag la thim pas khams gsum thams cad rang dbang med par dmar ltem gyis bdag gis dbang du gyur/ bdag nyid mthong thos dran reg tsam gyis 'gro ba mtha' dag gi yid 'phrog cing dbang du byed pa'i rje btsun ma dngos yin snyam pa'i ngang nas/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswā hā/ zhes bzla'o// bsnyen pa byed skabs 'di yan gyis mthus shing*/ rgyun gyi nyams len gyi skabs sogs dmigs bya ched du gtad pa yod na hrīḥyig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer dmar po phyogs bcur 'phros pa'i sna la ku ru kul+le dmar mo nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa lcags kyu dang zhags pa lcags sgrogs thogs pa srid gsum khyab par 'phros/ de dag na yod pa'i sems can thams cad dang*/ khyad par bsgrub bya gang dbang du bya bar 'dod pa de nyid 'od zer gyi lcags kyus snying nas drangs/ zhags pas rke nas bcings/ lcags sgrogs kyi yan lag bsdams/ 'od zer dmar po'i shugs kyis rang dbang med par bskyod nas rang gi mdun du lus 'od dmar po'i rang bzhin dmar lam lam zhu la khad du bsam/

ma dad ma gus pa la sogs pa'i snang ba thams cad 'gags shing bdag nyid kho na la chags pa'i dbang du 'dus nas rang sems dang dbyer med du gyur/ de nyid brjod bral bde ba chen por rang ngo shes par byas la mnyam par bzhag oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswā hā/ zhes bzla'o// de ltar tsan+dan dmar po'i phreng ba 'dzin pas/ myur ba dang dal ba dang mi gsal ba'i lhag chad rnams spangs shing tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par/ thun bzhi'i tshul gyis bzlas pa dngos dang nyams dang rmi lam du bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku dngos mthong ba dang*/ gsung thos pa dang*/ bde chen gyi ye shes rgyud la skye ba sogs/ nges can du 'byung ba ni mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa'o// 'bum phrag bcu la sogs pa bzlas pa ni grangs kyis bsnyen pa'o// 'bru 'bum gyis 'bum phrag brgyad

dag po paṇ+ḍi ta dang rmor chen gyi gsungs/ gsungs pa'ang 'byung ngo*// gang ltar grangs ci tsam mang ba dang mtshan ma thob na mchog tu 'gyur ro// zla ba drug tshig dril du bya ba ni/ tshar chen gsungs dus kyi bsnyen pa'o// de dag thun mtshams rnams su bogs dbyung ba'i phyir bla ma'i man ngag las byung ba'i bdag byin gyis rlabs pa'i rim pa bsgom/ lta ba zung 'jug gis rgyas 'debs pa ni khyad par gyi gdams pa'o// de nas bzlas pa'i mthar/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma ku ru kul+les bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ khyad par du brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad bdag cag dpon slob kyis dbang du 'dus par mdzad du gsol/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ bsang chu bsgrub pa ni/ nang mchod nas bsang chu la gtor/ oṃ mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sham̐ las byung ba'i dung phor mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i bsang chu dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ rdzas thams cad kyi ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ a mṛ ta'am/ hūm̐ ring po bdun nam nyer gcig brjod/ mchod rdzas rnams la bsang chu gtor/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da aḥhūm̐ gis bar/ 'bru gsum dang spel ba phyag rgyar bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi dang rol chen bya/ bsreg rdzas rnams la sngar bzhin bsang chu gtor/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/

hūm̐ las byung ba'i bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa dbang gi las thams cad myur du bsgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje khu tshur las gung mdzub gnyis bshibs pa chos 'byung gi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī swā hā/ oṃ dzīṃ swā hā/ oṃ swa swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ ces pas rdzas rnams sbyangs shing byin gyis brlabs/ de nas thab khung la bsang chu gtor/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dbang gi thab khung zla gam dmar po kha khyer mu ran dang bcas pa/ de'i phyi rol du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis yongs su gang bar gyur/ ces brjod 'di nas bzung ste ma grol bar lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' bar bya'o// me bsgrub pa ni/ smad 'tshong ma'am/ tshos mkhan mi me las/ sngar gyi spor lde sbar la lag pa gnyis char gyis bzung nas/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswā hā/ zhes brjod cing thab la g.yas nas bskor te me tshang du bcug la thab kyi nang gi ting lo sbar/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod/ rtsa skam dang shing sreg la sogs pa bcug sngags de nyid brjod cing mar khu blug gzar gsum blug rlung yab cung zad g.yab ste me gso'o// skabs 'dir me pra brtag cing ngan na a mṛ ta'am/ hūm̐ ring po brjod la phyogs thams cad du bsang chu gtor bas bgegs bsal/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod la thun mong gi srung 'khor bsgom/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me de nyid bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las thab kyi nang ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du ram̐ dmar po las me lha sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas dbyug gu dmar po dang*/

g.yon bgrang phreng dmar po 'dzin pa/ gsus khyim che zhing dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog can/ smra ra'i a tshom dang*/ tshangs pa'i skud pa 'chang ba/ 'od zer dmar pos sems can thams cad dbang du byed pa/ ra skyes dmar po'i steng na pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par aḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lho nas me lha ye shes pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes brjod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'am/ dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blug zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbus brgyan par bsam/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bstan te/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhū ta dz+wa la ya sarba bhasmī ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭān hūm̐ phaṭa tṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas dam la bzhag oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar mtshan sngags re re sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga dang ghan+dhe ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ sngags de de nyid kyis mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// drang srong chen po me yi lha// nyon mongs bsreg pa'i shes rab 'od// me lha mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// ces pas bstod/

sngar gyi ku sha'i chun po brgyad lag pa g.yon du bzung la/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bag pa dang ma dag pa thams cad sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin// des bdag rnal 'byor pa 'khor dang bcas pa la gegs med cing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ rang gi mdun nas g.yas bskor gyi rim pas oṃ badz+ra sa twa āḥ zhes brjod cing*/ thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du snga ma'i rtse mo phyi ma'i rtsa bas non par bkram/ byon zan 'bul ba ni/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i lce hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i rtse mor raṃ bsam/ dgang blugs kyi gzar bu'i rtse la'ang raṃ bsam/ gzar bu gnyis pus mo gnyis kyi bar du tshud par byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun brjod cing mar blug gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la/ gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la thab la g.yas su bskor zhing me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsams la/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī bya dī bya ma hā shri ye ha bya ka bya ba ha nā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de lta bu lan gsum dbul/ de nas yam shing la sogs pa 'og nas byung ba'i sreg rdzas rnams rim pa bzhin lag pa g.yon du bzung la g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng nas blangs shing 'og nas bskor te mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul/ de yang yam shing byang chub kyi shing du mos te/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swāhā/ zhes pa bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs pa 'bul ba'i mthar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya khams gsum snod bcud thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'dus par gyur cig ces pa'am yang na khams gsum snod bcud thams cad ma ma wa shaṃ ku ru ho/

ces pa'am bsgrub bya dmigs kyi bsal ba yod na de'i ming gis mthar/ wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ ces pa'am/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong lta bu yin na sngags kyi rjes su bdag gi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa/ bar du gcod pa thams cad dang gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shin+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang de'i rig pas shes par byas te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes pas mar dang*/ oṃ sarba pā pam̐ da ha na badz+ra ya swā hā/ zhes pas til lam yungs dkar dang*/ oṃ sarba paṃ pa da swā hās zho dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swā hās 'bras so ba dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ya swā hās 'bras dang*/ oṃ mahā be gā ya swā hās nas dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swā hās gro dang*/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hās sran ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hās dur ba dang*/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ya swā hās ku sha rnams phul la sde tshan re re'i mthar gong ltar gyi spel tshig sbyar ro// de ltar me lha la bsreg rdzas ci tsam 'byor pa phul ba'i mthar gong ltar mchod bstod byas la/ a mṛ tas bsang chu ku shas gtor/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hās mchod yon phyag tu phul/ mar blugs gzar gang thab tu blugs te/ oṃ badz+ra dzā la raṃ zhes brjod pas me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me de nyid bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gyi nang dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi dbus su rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma ku ru kul+le yan lag bzhi rdzogs pa'i cho gas bskyed pa dkyus bzhin bya/ de nas/ oṃ ku ru kul+le sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro bas chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pa sngags dang phyag rgyas dbul ba'i mthar/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pa bya/ sngags de nyid kyi rjes su 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod dbul/

brtse bas rjes chags sogs bstod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas bstod/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswā hā/ zhes yi ge brgyad pa lan 'ga' zhig brjod pas mar la bsngags te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes pa lan bdun gyis blug gzar gyis mar khu blugs pas dgang gzar bkang ba'i mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī bya dī bya zhes sogs kyi mthar/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad ma ma wā sham̐ ku ru hoḥ zhes brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la g.yas su bskor bas rje btsun ma'i zhal gdangs par phul bar bsams la/ de lta bu'i dgang blug bdun tshan gsum gyis byon zan 'bul/ de nas yam shing nas brtsams te bsreg rdzas rnams lan bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs pa 'bul ba la re re'i thog mar lha sngags yi ge brgyad pa'i mthar/ rdzas sngags so so'i spel tshig gong ltar brjod cing bsgrub g.yog gcig gis logs nas grangs nges pa can bzung bas 'bul/ bsdu na rdzas re re'i mgor lha sngags re dang bar du rdzas sngags kho na bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs pa'i mthar las sngags spel tshig tshar re yod pas phul ba'i mthar/ dbang gi sbyin sreg rdzas kyis gtso bo pad+ma rak+ta/ tsan+dan dmar po/ me tog dmar po lcags kyu can gyi rigs gang mang gi phye ma mngar gsum/ lan tshwa rnams/ zas mchog dang sbyar ba'i ril bu lug gi ril ma tsam mchal lam/ li khri'am/ rgya skyegs kyis kha dog bsgyur ba ci mang 'bul/ de yang sngags yi ge brgyad pa'i mthar/ bsgrub bya dmigs kyi bsal ba yod na de nyid kyi ming gi mthar spel tshig sbyar/ med na gong ltar khams gsum snod bcud thams cad ma ma wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes sogs nub re la stong phrag lnga'am khri la sogs pa 'bul zhing skabs skabs su yam shing dang mar ci 'byor pa phul/ sgrub g.yog gis me rgyun mi chad pa'i bud shing yang 'jug go /de yang yam shing ni me 'od 'bar ba'i dkyil du 'bul/

zhu ba'i rdzas rnams ni zhal du 'bul/ gong bu'i rdzas rnams ni phyag tu 'bul/ ku sha ni dbu'i gtsug tor du 'bul/ de ltar phul bas rje btsun ma thugs shin tu mnyes nas brtse ba dang*/ chags pa dang*/ sgeg pa dang*/ spyan zur g.yo ba la sogs pa rnam rol du ma bsgyur ba'i sku las 'od zer dmar po nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ lcags kyu dang zhags pa lcags sgrog gi rnam pa srid gsum thams cad khyab par 'phros/ de dag na yod pa'i sems can thams cad dang*/ khyad par bsgrub bya gang dbang du bya bar 'dod pa de nyid 'od zer gyi/ lcags kyus snying nas drangs/ zhags pas rke nas bcings/ lcags sgrog gis yan lag thams cad bsdams/ 'od zer dmar po'i shugs kyis rang dbang med par bskyod nas/ rang gi mdun du lus 'od dmar po'i rang bzhin dmar lam lam zhu la khad du bsam/ ma dad ma gus pa la sogs pa'i snang ba thams cad 'gags shing bdag nyid kho na la chags pas dbang du 'dus nas rang sems dang dbyer med du gyur/ de nyid brjod bral bde ba chen por rang ngo shes par byas la mnyam par bzhag mthar gshegs skyems su byon zan gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang blugs bdun tshan gsum 'bul/ gong ltar phyi nang gi mchod pa bstod pa dang bcas pa bya/ de nas gtor ma byin rlabs sgrub thabs ltar ram/ bsdu na/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥs phyag rgyas bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ rje btsun ma'i zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung bas gtor ma drangs shing gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ ku ru kul+le i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi kha hi/ zhes pa gsum mam lnga la sogs pa brjod cing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i mthar se gol gtogs/ slar yang phyi nang gi mchod pa bstod pa dang bcas pa'i mthar/ rig byed dbang mo 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la// ces pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog

/gi bar dang thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma ku ru kul+le bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bsgrub bya dmigs kyis bsal ba yod na/ de nyid kyi gtsos byas pa'i khams gsum snod bcud thams cad rang dbang med par bde blag tu bdag gi dbang du 'dus par mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// zhes pa sogs sh+lo ka gcig dang*/ bdag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas/ zhes pa nas/ bzod par mdzad de lhag chad kha bskang bar mdzad du gsol/ gyi bar brjod/ oṃ/ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad// sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥzhes dang lag pa gnyis snying khar kha phyir bstan te bsnol ba'i se gol gyi sgras ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis thab nang nas thal ba cung zad blangs ste rang gi dpral bar byug dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par bsam/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha slar yang mchod pa ni/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la ram̐/ ces brjod la mar blug gzar gang thab tu blug pa'i rkyen gyis me lha 'bar ba'i rnam pa las skad cig gis rang gzugs su byon par bsam la/ yam shing nas/ ku sha'i bar gyi bsreg rdzas ji ltar 'byor pa lan gsum mam/ lnga'am/ bdun la sogs pa phul ba'i mthar/ gshegs skyems su byon zan gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang blug bdun tshan gsum phul/ mchod bstod rnams sngar bzhin bya/ de nas gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ lag pa g.yas g.yon dbus gsum bya khyung gi phyag rgya rnams bstan/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas pa lan gsum mam/ lngas gtor ma phul/

sngar ltar mchod bstod byas pa'i mthar/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pas phrin las bcol/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ces pa'i rjes la 'dod don gsol ba btab/ gong ltar lhag chad kha skong*/ bzod par gsol/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur pa'i skabs ltar bsang chu gtor/ mchod yon phul/ spyan drangs pa'i dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed/ oṃ/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// bsgrubs kyis bzhud cig byin za khyod// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ ag+na ye gats+tshaḥces pas/ me lha ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma ku ru kul+ler gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ zhes brjod pas gnas gsum du rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo 'bru gsum gyis mtshan par bsam/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ku ru kul+le 'grub gyur nas sogs nas 'god par shog tshe ring nad med 'byor ldan zhing*// 'gro kun rtag tu 'dun pa dang*// ji ltar bsam pa'i don rnams kun// chos bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol// gzhan yang skye ba 'di nyid du// mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang*// tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs// rtag tu bde dang ldan gyur cig /ces pas smon lam dang*/ yid 'phrog pad+ma rā ga'i ri bo bzhin// yid can snying rtsa 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu yis// yid bzhin dngos grub ster mdzad lhag pa'i lha// yid 'ong rig byed lha mo'i bkra shis shog /ces sogs skabs 'brel gyi shis brjod bya/ me ma shi bar du mi reg cing*/ long med na 'o ma kha dog dmar por bsgyur bas gzhil la/ snod gtsang mar bsdu/

thab kyi shul dang nye 'khor thams cad dri zhim po'i chus byugs/ slar yang me tog bsil ma 'thor zhing bkra shis rgyas par brjod/ thal ba de nyid la mthon po'i rtse rlung la phyar ba'am/ bsgrub bya gang yin pa la sogs pa sems can mang pos 'thung ba'i chu klung la sbyangs par bya'o// de ltar rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i gnad yig zhes bya ba rang nyid kyis brtsams pa las/ sbyin sreg gi dbang du bya ba ni gzhan du shes par bya'o zhes pa'i lag len gsal bar bstan pa'i yi ge 'di ni/ sde snod rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pa'i mkhas pa chen po chos kyi rje brag dmar mkhan chen rab bstan dpal 'bar ba'i gsung gis rgyangs ring po nas nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i snyan brgyud zab mo 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor pa blo gsal rgya mtshos/ rang gi bsti gnas kyi bsam gtan gyi khang bur sbyar ba 'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig dbang la dbus nas khru phyed dor// thab kyi nang gi 'dab brgyad bya// dbus nas shar du sor gsum 'phags// tshangs dang nub zlum 'phrad mtshams kyi// bar gyi tshad des byang shar dang*// shar lho zur thig la reg bskor// de yi phyi ru sor bzhi pa// lan gnyis sngar bzhin zur thig la// reg pas bskor bas kha khyer dang*// mu ran 'byung ngo shar phyogs kyi// zur thig gnyis dang zlum bskor 'phrad// mtshams de thad dkar bcad pa yis// zla gam 'byung ngo kha khyer dang*// mu ran gnyis la'ang de bzhin bcad// //dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o//
